description: This file provides utility functions for retrieving device, OS, and application version information on iOS devices. It defines an enum `DeviceInfoHelper` with static methods to generate platform strings, device family, model identifier, app version, and build info, primarily for display or payload purposes.

methods.name: platformString
methods.description: Returns a string describing the platform and OS version, such as 'iOS 18.0.0' or 'iPadOS 18.0.0', based on device interface idiom.

methods.name: platformStringForDisplay
methods.description: Returns a string for UI display, always in the format 'iOS X.Y.Z', matching legacy behavior.

methods.name: deviceFamily
methods.description: Returns the device family as a string, e.g., 'iPad', 'iPhone', or 'iOS'.

methods.name: modelIdentifier
methods.description: Retrieves the device's machine model identifier, such as 'iPhone17,1', using uname.

methods.name: appVersion
methods.description: Returns the application's marketing version string, e.g., '2026.2.0' or 'dev' if not set.

methods.name: appBuild
methods.description: Returns the app's build string, or an empty string if not set.

methods.name: openClawVersionString
methods.description: Combines app version and build info into a display string, e.g., '1.2.3 (456)'.
